deployment.purpose: Re-run the namespace-scoped AgentOps component with the shared Arena embedding endpoint before enabling its Launchpad GitOps path

semantic_retrieval.query: FHA borrower eligibility requirements and mortgage insurance

mlflow_tracking.reason: The expected mlflow.redhat-ods-applications service does not exist on Arena, so application tracing initialization cannot resolve the host.

launchpad_order_showroom_and_entitlement.reason: The draft catalog remains fail closed until the shared observability capabilities and GitOps activation gate are ready.

arena_capacity.pilot_alternative: Add targeted Launchpad tolerations for the three control-plane nodes only after explicit control-plane risk certification.

embedding_ingestion.red: The previous live AgentOps seat stored all 41 chunks without vectors because no compatible shared embedding endpoint was available.
embedding_ingestion.green: The shared Nomic service embedded all 41 chunks at 768 dimensions and semantic search returned the expected FHA sections.

disposable_storage.red: Reclaim through Arena's general nfs-storage class left three Released Retain PVs and three backing directories.
disposable_storage.green: A Launchpad-only Delete/no-archive StorageClass passed a live PVC, PV, and backing-directory deletion probe.

event_capacity.red: Only two worker nodes are schedulable, so 193 current worker pods plus 500 event pods exceed the 500-slot ceiling.

test_strategy.TDD: Failing storage-class and immutable evidence contracts preceded the cleanup correction and this evidence artifact.
test_strategy.EDD: This artifact records live capacity, readiness, database vector counts, semantic similarity results, WebSocket behavior, storage leakage, correction, and zero-residue checks.
test_strategy.CDD: The AgentOps catalog, intake contract, chart defaults, and Arena StorageClass now agree on launchpad-nfs-ephemeral.
test_strategy.BDD: Given a disposable AgentOps seat using the shared Nomic endpoint, all seeded chunks receive vectors, an FHA query retrieves the expected sections, the agent completes, and exact reclaim leaves no session data.
test_strategy.CBT: Application health, PostgreSQL vector state, TEI retrieval, WebSocket generation, DSPA, MLflow failure, PVC reclaim, PV reclaim, and NFS-directory deletion were checked independently.

remaining_release_gates: shared MLflow tracking server and participant route
Launchpad-created runtime Secret, workload Application, Showroom, entitlement, and reclaim
at least two additional 250-pod workers or separately approved control-plane scheduling

security.legacy_data_deletion_scope: Only the three exact PV directories created by launchpad-cert-agentops-sep17a were removed.
